about.title: Serving Galveston County from Texas City for over 40 years
text: Our Texas City office staff has served the Galveston County area for over 40 years, and we also have an office in New Braunfels.
Bookkeeping no longer needs in-house staff and the overhead that comes with it, so we do it online and you can reach your financial information anytime.
We prepare returns for individuals, partnerships, corporations, estates and trusts, and we built a system that makes filing quick and easy, including for clients overseas or working remotely.
Satisfied clients and their referrals are our main source of new business, and we guarantee the confidentiality of client information.
